datasets.title: Transcriptomic Profiling Reveals Ageing-Related Molecular Signatures in Women with Diminished Ovarian Reserve
datasets.summary: The increasing incidence of diminished ovarian reserve (DOR) among women undergoing assisted reproductive technology (ART) poses significant challenges, as DOR is associated with lower pregnancy and live birth rates. This study aimed to investigate the molecular signatures related to ageing in women with DOR and their potential implications for understanding the underlying mechanisms of DOR. We collected peripheral blood samples from 20 infertile women under 40 years of age, including 10 patients with DOR and 10 with normal ovarian reserve (NOR). Using DESeq2, we identified differentially expressed genes (DEGs) between the DOR and NOR groups. DOR-related ageing genes were obtained by intersecting DEGs with three senescence-related databases (CellAge, CSGene, SenMayo). Transcriptomic profiling identified 14 ageing-related DEGs, of which E2F2, SYT1, BNIP3L, AREG, FOXO3, CTNNAL1, RBM38, BCL2L1, ALOX15B, MITF, TOP1, TRIM10, and PCGF2 were upregulated, and PROX1 was downregulated, in the DOR group. Functional enrichment analysis indicated a strong association between these DEGs and processes related to oxidative stress, apoptosis, and mitochondrial dysfunction. The findings underscore the systemic molecular ageing abnormalities present in women with DOR, providing insights into potential targets for therapeutic intervention aimed at improving ART outcomes.

evidence.sequencing_type: miRCURY LNA miRNA Array 芯片杂交检测血清 miRNA，geo_data_type 为 Non-coding RNA profiling by array，未测序，故为 miRNA microarray。
evidence.survival_analysis: 仅6例样本且无生存时间/状态字段，无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较为DOR vs 正常，无药物治疗干预对照
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: miRNA array表达平台，疾病组DOR(n=3) vs 对照组Normal(n=3)均为独立正常育龄女性血清，有正向健康标签，排除P1-P6陷阱
evidence.correlation: DOR患者仅3例，远不足≥16例的样本量要求
evidence.sample_source: GSM source/characteristics 均为 serum，直接从血清提取 RNA 进行 miRNA 芯片检测，未经细胞分选或体外培养，属于外周血直接组分，归 blood。
